home.description: A unified digital platform for the Quran, Hadith, learning, library and media resources of Minhaj-ul-Quran International.
home.lede: A unified digital platform for the Quran, Hadith, learning, library and media resources of Minhaj-ul-Quran International.
home.buildStatus: The platform is being built in stages. What is available now is the public shell: the navigation, the structure, and the routes each area will occupy. Published content arrives with the phase that delivers it.
home.exploreIntro: Sections describing the organisation, its leadership and its work. Each section is published as it is completed.
home.accountBody: An account is optional. Everything published here can be read without one; My Minhaj is for the parts of the platform that need to know who you are.

footer.preAdoption: One Minhaj is an independently developed platform. It is not currently commissioned, sponsored, adopted or deployed by Minhaj-ul-Quran International, and nothing here should be read as an official statement by the organisation.

reserved.heading: Not yet published
reserved.body: This page is reserved. Its content is prepared and approved by Minhaj-ul-Quran International and published through the platform’s editorial review process. Nothing on this page is an official statement by the organisation.

sitemap.description: Every public page on this platform. Sections marked reserved exist but have no published content yet.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This page could not be displayed. You can try again; if the problem continues, it has been recorded for the people who maintain the platform.

common.unavailable: Something went wrong. Try again shortly.

confirmChange.description: Confirm that {email} is yours. Your other devices will be signed out.
confirmChange.done: Your email address has been changed.
confirmChange.invalid: This link is no longer usable. Request the change again from your security settings.
confirmChange.needSignIn: Sign in to the account you are changing, then open this link again.

denied.signedOut: You need to sign in to see this.

forgot.submitted: If that address has an account, a link is on its way.

language.title: Language and time zone

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in with it now.
reset.invalid: This link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
reset.expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.

security.title: Security
security.description: Your password, your active sessions and your account.
security.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Other devices were signed out.
security.passwordWrong: That current password is not right.
security.changeEmailHelp: We will send a link to the new address to confirm it.
security.emailSubmitted: If that address can be used, a confirmation link is on its way.
security.sessionsHelp: Where your account is signed in. Sign out anywhere you do not recognise.
security.methodsHelp: How you sign in. More options will be added later.
security.methodFinal: This is your only way to sign in, so it cannot be removed.
security.closeHelp: Closing removes your sign-in details and signs you out everywhere. Your email address becomes free to use again, and a new account made with it starts from nothing.
security.closeConfirm: Enter your password to close the account
security.twoFactorHelp: An authenticator app produces a short code that changes every thirty seconds. It is required before any administrative capability can be used.
security.stateEnrolled: Two-step verification is on, and your recovery codes are saved.
security.stateIncomplete: Two-step verification is set up, but you have not confirmed that you saved your recovery codes. Administrative capabilities stay unavailable until you do.
security.stateReenrol: Two-step verification was reset by an operator. Set it up again to restore administrative capabilities.
security.enrolIntro: Enter your password to begin. You will be shown a setup key and a set of recovery codes.
security.enrolUriHelp: Add this to your authenticator app. It is shown once.
security.enrolCodesHelp: Save these somewhere safe. Each one works once, and they are shown only now.
security.verifyHelp: Enter the current code from your authenticator app to finish.
security.regenerateHelp: A new set is issued and every unused code from the old set stops working. You will need to confirm the new set.
security.disableHelp: Requires your password and either a current code or one recovery code. If you have lost both, an operator must run the audited recovery procedure.
security.disabled: Two-step verification is off, and every device was signed out.
security.notEnrolled: Two-step verification is not set up on this account.
security.alreadyEnrolled: Two-step verification is already set up.

setup.title: Finish setting up
setup.description: Choose the language and time zone for your account. You can change both later.

signIn.description: Sign in to your Minhaj account. The rest of the site is open to everyone without one.
signIn.failed: Those details did not match an account.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: An account saves your place and lets you take part. Reading, searching and listening need no account.
signUp.submitted: Check your email for a link to confirm your address.

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.description: Confirm this address to finish setting up your account.
verify.done: Your address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.invalid: This link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
verify.expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
verify.missing: This link is incomplete. Open it again from your email.
verify.resent: If that address needs confirming, a link is on its way.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Your password was accepted. Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
twoFactor.codeHelp: Six digits, from the app you set up.
twoFactor.failed: That code was not accepted. Check the app and try again.
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Enter one of the single-use codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each code works once.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Identity, access and platform operations. Every action is checked on the server and recorded.

global.title: Global Network

scope.countries: Every Country in the directory, in any state. A Country is the top of the hierarchy; Regions, Cities and Centres each belong to exactly one.
scope.regions: Regions are optional subdivisions of a Country. A Country may have none, and a City may sit directly under its Country.
scope.cities: Cities belong to one Country and, where meaningful, to one of its Regions.
scope.centres: Centres are the organisation's local presences. A Centre names a City, or a Region only, or neither — and a virtual Centre has no physical place at all.

global.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
global.denied: You do not have permission to change the Global Network directory.
global.invalid: Some of the details are not valid. Check each field and try again.
global.conflict: This record changed. Reload it before trying again.
global.duplicateSlug: This slug is already used by another record at the same level.
global.duplicateCode: Another Country already has this ISO code.
global.duplicateContact: This centre already lists that contact.
global.duplicateCity: This centre already serves that city.
global.limit: This centre already has as many entries here as it can hold.
global.countryFixed: A region or city stays in the Country it was created in. Archive it and create one in the right Country.
global.servedCities: Remove the cities this centre serves before moving it to another Country.
global.stateHelp: Draft is private. Published is public once every place above it is public too. Archived withdraws it without deleting it.
global.empty: Nothing matches. Clear the filters, or create the first record.
global.name: Name
global.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It forms the public address; changing it keeps the old address working as a redirect.
global.codeHelp: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 code, for example GB. It is stored in capitals.
global.primaryLocaleHelp: The language this record is first named in. It must have a name in that language.
global.namesHelp: Give the name in each language you have it in. Leave a language empty to give no name in it.
global.countryNone: There are no Countries yet. Create a Country first.
global.chooseCountryFirst: Choose the Country first. The page then offers that Country’s regions.
global.countryFixedHelp: A region or city stays in the Country it was created in. To place it in another Country, archive it and create one there.
global.regionCountryHelp: Choose carefully: a region never leaves the Country it is created in.
global.cityRegionHelp: Only this Country’s regions are offered. Changing it moves every centre in this city with it.
global.cityCountryStepHelp: A city never leaves the Country it is created in. Choosing one reloads the page with that Country’s regions.
global.centreCountryStepHelp: Choosing a Country reloads the page with its cities and regions.
global.centreCountryHelp: Choosing another Country reloads the page with its cities and regions. A move is refused while this centre serves cities; remove them first.
global.centreMoving: This centre will move to the Country shown below when you save. Choose its city or region there.
global.citySearch: Find a city by name or slug
global.citySearchHelp: Narrows the city lists below. At most 300 cities are offered at once; search to reach the rest.
global.localityHelp: Choose a city, or — only when there is no city — a region. Not both: a centre in a city takes its region from that city.
global.centreCityHelp: Cities of the Country above, in any state; a draft or archived city says so.
global.centreRegionHelp: Use only when the centre has no city.
global.virtualHelp: A virtual centre has no physical city, region, coordinates or address. Leave those empty when you tick this.
global.coordinatesHelp: Optional. Decimal degrees exactly as the organisation supplied them, up to six decimal places — both or neither. Nothing is looked up automatically.
global.centreWordsHelp: Fill in each language you have. A language left entirely empty is not shown; a description or address needs a name in the same language.
global.descriptionHelp: A short public description of the centre.
global.addressHelp: The postal address as the organisation supplied it. Leave empty for a virtual centre.
global.contactsHelp: Shown publicly on the centre’s page, in this order. {count} of {limit}.
global.contactsFull: This centre has as many contacts as it can hold. Remove one to add another.
global.contactValueHelp: A website must be a full https:// address. A phone number is shown exactly as given, with its country code where it has one.
global.servedHelp: Further cities in this centre’s Country that it also serves. {count} of {limit}.
global.servedEmpty: This centre serves no further cities.
global.servedFull: This centre serves as many cities as it can. Remove one to add another.
global.addServedHelp: Only cities of this centre’s own Country are offered, and none it already serves.
global.addServedNone: No further cities of this Country are available. Create one, or narrow the city search above.

denied.secondFactorRequired: Set up two-step verification and confirm your recovery codes before using this.
denied.stepUpRequired: Confirm it is you before making this change.
denied.selfElevation: You cannot change your own privileges. Ask another administrator.
denied.finalAdministrator: This is the last Platform Administrator. Grant the role to someone else first.
denied.protectedRole: Protected system roles cannot be changed here.
denied.duplicateKey: A role with that key already exists.
denied.unknownPermission: That permission is not in the catalogue.
denied.ineligibleTarget: That account is not eligible to hold this role.
denied.invalidInput: Check the values and try again.
denied.unavailable: That did not work. Try again.

users.title: Accounts
users.description: Identity accounts and their status. Search by the start of an address or a name.
users.name: Name
users.changed: The account status was changed and its sessions were revoked.
users.invalidTransition: That status change is not allowed from the current one.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: A role is a named bundle of permissions. Protected system roles are fixed; custom roles are managed here.
roles.protectedNote: This role is migration-controlled. Its name and its permissions cannot be changed, and it cannot be deactivated.
roles.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It never changes.
roles.name: Name
roles.bundleUpdated: The permissions were saved, and everyone holding the role was signed out.
roles.deactivated2: The role was deactivated, and everyone holding it was signed out.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: The permission catalogue. It is fixed by migration and cannot be changed at runtime; roles are where permissions are bundled.
permissions.unknown: This build does not describe this permission.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.description: Which account holds which role, and the history of every grant and revoke.
assignments.grantAccountHelp: The internal identifier from the accounts list, not an address.
assignments.grantedMessage: The role was granted, and the account was signed out so the change takes effect.
assignments.alreadyHeld: That account already holds the role.
assignments.revokedMessage: The assignment was revoked, and the account was signed out.

security.title: Identity security
security.description: Privileged second-factor state and the status of the one-time administrator bootstrap. Read-only.
security.reenrolment: Re-enrolment required after an operator recovery
security.administrators: Accounts holding the Platform Administrator role
security.hostOnly: The bootstrap and the lockout recovery are host-only commands run by an operator against the database. They are not available from this or any other page, by design.

taxonomy.description: Canonical topics, the content languages the platform publishes in, and editorial tags.

denied.topicProtected: This is a canonical topic. Its slug, place and lifecycle are fixed; its translations are not.
denied.topicArchived: That topic is archived. Restore it first.
denied.topicHasActiveChildren: This topic still has active child topics. Archive or move them first.
denied.duplicateSlug: That slug is already in use.
denied.duplicateLanguageCode: A content language with that code already exists.
denied.hierarchyCycle: A topic cannot be moved beneath one of its own descendants.
denied.hierarchyTooDeep: That move would make the topic hierarchy too deep.
denied.fallbackRequired: Every topic keeps its English name — it is what the other languages fall back to.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: The canonical subject taxonomy. Every topic has a stable slug, a place in the hierarchy and a name in each interface language.
topics.caption: Topics at this level, in display order
topics.name: Name
topics.canonicalNote: This is one of the canonical top-level topics. Its slug, its place in the hierarchy and its lifecycle are fixed foundation data. Its names and descriptions can be translated here.
topics.shownInFallback: Shown in {locale} — no translation for this language yet.
topics.noChildren: No topics at this level yet. Create one below.
topics.createHere: The new topic will be created under {parent}.
topics.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. This permanent identifier appears in links, so choose it carefully.
topics.fallbackNameHelp: Required. Every other language falls back to this name when it has no translation of its own.
topics.descriptionHelp: Optional. Leave it empty rather than writing a placeholder.
topics.translationsHelp: A topic is named separately in each interface language. The {locale} name is required; the others are optional and fall back to it.
topics.moveHelp: Choose where this topic sits. A topic cannot be moved beneath one of its own descendants.
topics.archiveHelp: Archiving retires a topic without deleting it. Topics are never deleted, so nothing that refers to one can be left pointing at nothing.

mapping.title: Topic mapping
mapping.description: Which kinds of content can be classified by a topic, and how that classification is enforced by the database.
mapping.none: Nothing can be assigned a topic yet.
mapping.noneDetail: Topic assignment belongs to the part of the platform that owns the content being classified — articles, Quran, Hadith, Fatawa, courses and the rest. None of those has been built yet, so there is nothing to assign a topic to. This page lists real relationships as each one arrives.
mapping.enforced: The database enforces {count} typed topic-assignment relationships.
mapping.complete: Every detected relationship has real foreign keys at both ends.
mapping.incomplete: {count} detected relationships are incomplete because they have no real target foreign key.
mapping.ruleTitle: How a new kind of content gets topics
mapping.ruleOne: The part of the platform that owns the content creates its own relationship table, with a real reference to the topic and a real reference to its own record.
mapping.ruleTwo: It owns that table for its whole life, including what happens when a record is removed. Taxonomy never writes another area’s records.
mapping.ruleThree: It reads topics through the taxonomy service, never the database directly.
mapping.ruleProhibition: A single shared table holding a record type and an identifier is deliberately not offered. The database cannot enforce such a reference, so it would leave classifications pointing at content that no longer exists.

languages.title: Content languages
languages.description: The languages the platform publishes content in. A work written in Urdu is Urdu content whichever language the site is being read in.
languages.notInterfaceLocale: These are content languages, not site languages. The site is read in English, Urdu and Arabic, and nothing on this page changes that. Adding a content language here makes it available to describe content; it does not add a version of the site.
languages.caption: Content languages
languages.codeHelp: A standard language tag in lowercase, such as ur, ar or pa-arab.
languages.nativeNameHelp: Written in the language’s own script. This is what readers of that language will see.
languages.directionHelp: How text in this language is written. This describes the content, not the site.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Free-form editorial labels. Useful for grouping things loosely; never a substitute for a topic.
tags.notTopics: Tags are not topics. They have no hierarchy, no curation and no guarantees — if something needs to be findable by subject, give it a topic.
tags.caption: Tags
tags.label: Label
tags.labelHelp: What editors will see. Any script.
tags.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. This is what makes two editors typing the same tag produce one tag.
tags.searchHelp: Matches the beginning of a slug or a label.

navigation.title: Navigation status
navigation.description: The effective public shell: which routes exist, which are reserved placeholders, and which are still deferred to a later phase.
navigation.codeManaged: This is a read-only view. The shell route registry is managed in source and deployed with the application; there is no navigation record in the database and nothing on this page can be edited.
navigation.indexingDisabled: Public indexing is disabled for this deployment. Every page emits noindex, the crawler is disallowed and no sitemap is advertised, whatever a route is eligible for below.
navigation.indexingEnabled: Public indexing is enabled for this deployment. The routes marked eligible below are indexable and appear in the sitemap.
navigation.caption: Every route the public shell knows about, with its availability and indexing eligibility.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: The recorded history of security-relevant actions. Read-only, newest first.
audit.noPayload: Change payloads are recorded but not displayed here.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Outbound email provider configuration and status.
integrations.unavailable: Not configured — nothing is sent from this environment
integrations.webhookMissing: Signing secret absent — inbound events are refused
integrations.secretsNote: Credentials are never displayed here and cannot be edited from this page.

delivery.title: Mail delivery
delivery.description: Pending, failed and suppressed outbound mail. Recipients and message content are never recorded here.
delivery.retried: The delivery was put back on the schedule.

denied.duplicateSlug: That identifier is already in use by another contributor.
denied.accountAlreadyLinked: That account is already linked to a different contributor.
denied.personAlreadyLinked: This contributor already has an account linked. Unlink it first.
denied.accountNotFound: No account exists with that identifier.
denied.profileExists: This contributor already has that kind of profile.
denied.profileHasNoDetail: Author and speaker profiles have no descriptive fields of their own.
denied.duplicateVariant: That spelling is already recorded for this language.
denied.variantLimit: This contributor already has the maximum number of alternative names for that language.
denied.primaryTranslationRequired: A contributor keeps the entry for their original language. Remove another language instead.
denied.tooManyLanguages: That is more languages than a profile may list.

persons.title: Contributors
persons.description: The people who write, speak and teach. One record per person, with the author, speaker, scholar and teacher facets that apply.
persons.acceptanceNotice: Only enter people whose details the organisation has confirmed. Nothing here is published until you set a record to Published.
persons.searchHelp: Matches the start of an identifier or of a stored name.
persons.empty: No contributor records match. Create one below.
persons.caption: Contributors, ordered by identifier
persons.name: Name
persons.createHelp: The record is created as a draft. Nothing is public until you publish it.
persons.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. This permanent identifier appears in the public web address, so choose it carefully — it cannot be changed afterwards.
persons.primaryLocaleHelp: The language this person's details are written in first. Other languages fall back to it, and it cannot be removed.
persons.biographyHelp: Optional. Leave it empty rather than writing a placeholder.

editor.title: Editing {name}
editor.slugImmutable: Fixed when the record was created and not editable.
editor.statusHelp: Only a published contributor appears publicly or in a sitemap.
editor.translationsHelp: One entry per interface language. A language with no entry falls back to the original language, and the public page says so.
editor.variantsHelp: Other ways this person's name is written, up to {max} per language. Shown on the public profile.
editor.accountHelp: Optional. Most contributors have no account, and a historical author never will. Linking changes nothing about what the person is permitted to do.
editor.accountFieldHelp: Copy it from the Accounts screen. There is no account search here, so that managing contributors does not become a way to browse accounts.
editor.capabilitiesNotice: These are read-only. A profile grants nothing: what a person is permitted to do comes from a role assignment made on the Identity screens, and is shown here only so you can see it.
editor.capabilitiesCaption: Capabilities and the permission each is derived from
editor.profilesHelp: One person may hold any combination of the four. Each has its own status, and adding one grants nothing.
editor.addFacetHelp: Created as a draft. It appears publicly once you set it to Active.
editor.facetNoFields: This facet has no descriptive fields of its own — it records that the person is one.
editor.qualificationsHelp: Record only what the organisation has confirmed. This platform verifies nothing.
editor.facetBiographyHelp: What a prospective student reads. Separate from the main biography above.
editor.subjectsHelp: Written out in this language. Subject classification arrives with a later phase.
editor.languagesHelp: Language codes, separated by spaces — for example: ur en ar. Up to {max}.

author.title: Authors
author.description: Contributors who hold an author facet, including historical authors with no account.
author.empty: No contributor has an author facet yet.
author.caption: Contributors with an author facet

speaker.title: Speakers
speaker.description: Contributors who hold a speaker facet, for video and audio.
speaker.empty: No contributor has a speaker facet yet.
speaker.caption: Contributors with a speaker facet

scholar.title: Scholars
scholar.description: Contributors who hold a scholar facet, with their qualifications and areas of expertise.
scholar.empty: No contributor has a scholar facet yet.
scholar.caption: Contributors with a scholar facet
scholar.notice: A scholar facet is a description, not an appointment. It confers no religious authority and no permission to publish a Fatwa.

teacher.title: Teachers
teacher.description: Contributors who hold a teacher facet, with the subjects and languages they teach in.
teacher.empty: No contributor has a teacher facet yet.
teacher.caption: Contributors with a teacher facet
teacher.notice: A teacher facet is a description, not an approval. Permission to teach comes from a role assignment made on the Identity screens.

search.title: Search indexing
search.description: Indexing lag and failures. Search is derived from what each owner publishes; nothing here changes content.

categories.source-unavailable: The owner could not be read
categories.invalid-projection: The owner record was not searchable as provided
categories.index-write-failed: The index could not be written

search.retryHelp: Puts every scope waiting for an operator back on the schedule.
search.retried: Failed indexing was put back on the schedule.
search.reconcileHelp: Compares the index with what each owner publishes now, and re-indexes only what is missing, stale or withdrawn.
search.reconciled: Reconciliation has started. Anything it finds is indexed in the background; refresh this page to follow it.
search.rebuildHelp: Re-reads everything each owner publishes. Search keeps answering while it runs.
search.rebuilt: A full rebuild has started. It runs in the background; refresh this page to follow it.

people.fallbackNotice: This profile has not been translated into {requested} yet. It is shown in {shown}.

editorial.title: Editorial
editorial.unknown: This operation could not be completed. Please try again.
editorial.conflict: This record changed. Reload it before trying again.
editorial.denied: You do not have permission for this action.
editorial.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
editorial.invalid-state: This action is not available in the current state.
editorial.self-approval: You cannot approve your own work.
editorial.approval-required: A current independent approval is required.
editorial.name: Name
editorial.subject: Subject
editorial.heading: Heading
editorial.notice: This form is for general correspondence, not religious rulings. Do not send sensitive personal information.
editorial.author: Author
editorial.speaker: Speaker
editorial.revisionWarning: Saving a new revision returns this record to draft and withdraws published content. Approval and schedules are cleared.
editorial.authority-revoked: Scheduled publication stopped because current authority was revoked. Review and reschedule the record.
editorial.execution-failed: Scheduled publication failed. Reload, check the revision, and schedule it again.
editorial.referenceHelp: Choose a named suggestion or paste an existing identifier. Search before editing; searching reloads the form. Results are limited to 25 contributors.
editorial.issuerHelp: The body the statement is issued in the name of, written in this translation’s language. Required for every translation.
editorial.sourceHelp: Record only what is known. The address must be HTTPS and is shown as an outbound link; nothing is fetched from it. Summarise the coverage in your own words rather than pasting the outlet’s article.
editorial.slugReserved: A news slug cannot be archive, press-releases, statements or media-coverage.
editorial.centreHelp: Choosing or changing the Centre is an ordinary edit: it returns the article to draft and needs fresh review. An archived Centre stays named only while it is left unchanged.
editorial.eventCentreHelp: The Centre the event is held at, if any. Its address and place are shown from the Centre's own public record, never copied. Choosing or changing it is an ordinary edit: it returns the event to draft and needs fresh review. An archived Centre stays named only while it is left unchanged.
editorial.eventScheduleHelp: Enter each occurrence as the local date and time where the event is held, in the time zone below. This is when the event happens, not when this page is published. Changing it returns the event to draft and needs fresh review.
editorial.eventTimezoneHelp: The zone the local times are in, for example Asia/Karachi. Daylight saving is applied from this zone.
editorial.fold: If the clock repeats this hour
editorial.foldHelp: Only needed when the clocks go back and this local time happens twice.
editorial.foldEarlier: The first time (before the clocks go back)
editorial.foldLater: The second time (after the clocks go back)
editorial.moreOccurrences: Save to add more occurrences, up to twelve.
editorial.eventGalleriesHelp: Galleries of this event's photographs, in order. A gallery stays Media's; removing it here deletes nothing. Changing the galleries returns the event to draft and needs fresh review. Searching above narrows the galleries offered.
editorial.nonexistent-time: A start or end time does not exist in the event's time zone, because the clocks move forward then. Choose a time that exists.
editorial.ambiguous-time: A start or end time happens twice in the event's time zone, because the clocks go back then. Choose whether you mean the first or the second time.
editorial.schedule-order: Each occurrence must end after it starts.
editorial.duplicate-occurrence: Two occurrences start at the same time. Remove the duplicate.

library.title: Library
library.description: Books and written works, with their editions, translations and what is available to read or download.
library.metadataNotice: Titles and descriptions are shown in your interface language where they have been written. That does not mean a translated edition exists; translated editions are listed with the editions of each work.
